confirmed_guards: Only predeclared calibrated development worlds, regimes, seeds and candidate settings are accepted.
Private probe/assessment cohorts are rejected before archive access; scorer requests public identities and states only.
Confirmation requires frozen selected settings and discovery on separate declared development worlds; no other candidate modes are accepted.
All planned refitted baseline and alternative settings enter complete all-candidate selection audits; cached baselines are reference diagnostics.
Candidate comparisons within each complete audit share an outcome-free cross-method/candidate ID intersection, matching pools and common training-derived state scale.
Primary selector remains mean-over-worlds of the maximum of three pairwise normalized squared-state transport gaps; weighted objective losses are not ranked.
State probes fit StandardScaler/Ridge only on source-assay training states and transfer unchanged to target assays.
Matching uses shared latent arrays; true state joins follow pool selection and matching; private latent arrays are not matched.
Output directories are isolated, changed results cannot be overwritten, and model fitting holds suite/global plus GPU advisory locks.
Frozen scientific source pins remain unchanged; CLI changes are separately hashed and original first-fit CLI source is archived.

findings.description: public_run previously ignored study.validation_fit_sha256. It now checks the outer study receipt before trusting a validation export seal.

Cached baseline eligibility references constrain pools, but arbitrary later candidate cell losses could still change an all-candidate intersection. Interim and full results should be compared using their selected-ID hashes. These alternatives use unchanged frozen feature transformations, and the audited first fit preserved every expected cell.

scope: Read-only code/config review of declaration guards, public-only scorer, selection and confirmation comparison logic; no causal/assessment outcomes read and no training or CUDA operations for this review
scope_limits: No operating-system syscall trace of the completed fit was available; access boundaries were checked from frozen code, public input receipts and output identities.
The independent first-fit audit hashes checkpoints without deserializing their contents and reconciles input H5AD hashes against frozen manifests without reopening counts.
Scoring diagnostics assess alignment/conservation; they do not certify the unknown unpaired residual coupling or causal structure.
